name: layer
description: Layer skills: creative craft for AI game and entertainment asset generation.

plugins.name: 01.-getting-started
plugins.description: Connect to Layer and learn the generation loop every other skill builds on: model discovery, the spend gate, uploads, and polling.

plugins.name: 02.-direction
plugins.description: Agree a look before generating at volume: moodboards, storyboards, colour, era, and framing.

plugins.name: 03.-images
plugins.description: Generate stills and change the ones you already have: prompting, sizing, references, masked edits, reframing, upscaling, layers, and exact text in a brand font.

plugins.name: 04.-game-art
plugins.description: Art that has to sit in a system: characters and casts, environments, parallax and skyboxes, isometric and hex tilesets, 9-slice UI and icon sets, pixel sprites, HD sprite animation, VFX, and seamless textures.

plugins.name: 05.-video-and-audio
plugins.description: Generate motion and sound: animating stills, camera and shot language, multi-shot continuity, repairing a clip instead of rerolling it, talking characters and lip sync, sound effects, music, and speech.

plugins.name: 06.-editing-and-motion-graphics
plugins.description: Finish what you generated: cut shots into one video, give the cut a consistent look, animate logos, titles and end cards in the brand font, and render one template into many variants.

plugins.name: 07.-3d
plugins.description: Meshes for a game engine: generation from text or image, remeshing, retexturing, rigging, and animation.

plugins.name: 08.-marketing-and-live-ops
plugins.description: Creative that sells and sustains a game: user-acquisition ad matrices, store listing art, localised assets and dubs, and the upgrade chains and seasonal reskins a live game ships every week.

plugins.name: 09.-consistency-and-pipelines
plugins.description: Hold one look across a whole project with trained reference sets, run the Blueprint workflows a studio has already built, and import workflows from other tools.

plugins.name: 10.-review
plugins.description: Judge a batch before it ships: scoring rules, verdicts, and reviewing a set against the brief.
